name: VC Port
subtitle: VeraCrypt-compatible volumes on iPhone and iPad, built from source
description: Sideload VC Port. The app stays offline, uses no trackers, and is not named VeraCrypt. Portions are based in part on TrueCrypt, freely available at http://www.truecrypt.org/

apps.localizedDescription:
VC Port opens VeraCrypt-compatible volumes on iPhone. Not named VeraCrypt. Not unbreakable.

https://github.com/ShivamPingaleDev/Veracrypt_port
